lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ag4Hg4O8 (AgHgO2) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imma (No. 216), with 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ag centers with 4 O neighbors in a tetrahedral motif, Hg centers with 6 O neighbors in a trigonal bipyramidal motif, and O centers with 3 neighbors (1 Ag, 2 Hg). Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Ag tetrahedra and Hg trigonal bipyramids, and edge-sharing between Hg trigonal bipyramids. The periodic neighbor graph is 3-dimensional and connected across all 16 sites.
